title: Temporary Shared Instance State (Temporal Coupling Pipeline)
pattern: Storing temporary computation results in struct fields purely to pass variables between sequential method calls, requiring an implicit chronological calling order.
why_bad: Extremely fragile. Future maintainers can easily invoke `find_suffix` before `find_prefix` or invoke them concurrently, leading to silent calculation errors or stale state reuse with no compiler warnings.
detection: A method reads a struct field that is exclusively populated by another sibling method in the same struct, with no compiler-enforced sequence.
counterexample: Actual state-machine structs where the state transitions are compiler-enforced using the Type-State pattern.
